Inline <script>/<style> scan: index.html carries an inline importmap and an inline <style> block — twins readable/index-inline-N.pretty.{json,css} + readable/index-inline-map.json with byte ranges + sha256. Non-standalone parts are skipped sections, indexed but never sliced: a pure trailing export {…} table where one exists. Identifiers in src/ are the app's own declared names — no rename campaign applies (PLAN §5) since the served code is not minified. Capture bytes are untouched by everything above; re-cut with `node tools/derive.mjs` after any capture refresh. `node tools/audit.js` is the gate.
